keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row; the Ptolemaic Kingdom shape of 164-127 holds all of Egypt). A 40 km radius round Alexandria is the ptolemaic-kingdom dossier's own reading of the contested zone; the page names no other city or district under her control and says Ptolemy VIII 'had retained the allegiance of parts of Egypt'. No area on the page.

ledger.note: 131 BCE: Cleopatra II takes Alexandria. She 'led a rebellion against Ptolemy VIII in 132/1 BC' and drove him and Cleopatra III out of Alexandria at the end of 131 BC (the page's sentence as WebFetch reported it).
131 BCE: Alexandria passes from Ptolemy VIII to his sister-queen. The page: Ptolemy VIII 'had retained the allegiance of parts of Egypt' and expanded his control from there.
131 BCE: the civil war's fighting over Alexandria; the bibliography dates it 'entre 132 et 124 av. J.-C.', the ptolemaic-kingdom dossier 132.
127 BCE: 'In 127 BC, he took over Alexandria, Cleopatra II being forced to flee to Syria.'
127 BCE: Alexandria returns to Ptolemy VIII; Cleopatra II flees to Syria.
127 BCE: the rebel regime ends; Cleopatra II 'ruled in Alexandria as sole ruler until 127 BC'.

wars.name: Ptolemaic civil war (Cleopatra II against Ptolemy VIII)
wars.outcome: Cleopatra II held Alexandria as sole ruler from the end of 131 until Ptolemy VIII took it in 127; she fled to Syria. The page has a French bibliography entry 'la guerre civile en Egypte entre 132 et 124'.
wars.note: The civil war ran on to 124 (bibliography) with the Egyptian countryside under Ptolemy VIII; the Thebaid and other parts are not described. From set to 131, the state's first year: the page dates the rebellion '132/1' and the expulsion 'the end of 131' (reviewer me-05-x).

certainty.note: The extent of her control beyond Alexandria is not on the page.

sources.title: Cleopatra II of Egypt
sources.note: Rebellion 132/1, Alexandria driven out at the end of 131, sole ruler until 127, flight to Syria.

notes: One page (budget 1-2); the Ptolemy VIII page was opened (for Cyrene) but not for this. The ptolemaic-kingdom dossier opens its contest in 132 and closes it in 127, citing the Ptolemy VIII page; this dossier starts at the end of 131 (the Cleopatra II page) and names ptolemaic-kingdom as counterpart. The page does not say where else Cleopatra II ruled; Thebes and Upper Egypt are not mentioned. The Cliopatria Ptolemaic row has a shape -126..-111 and -164..-127; no shape isolates Alexandria.
